newsitem.title: CHINA: China March interest rate subsidy at 0.94 pct.
newsitem.headline: China March interest rate subsidy at 0.94 pct.

text.p: China's central bank, the People's Bank of China has set the March interest rate subsidy at 0.94 percent, the Financial News said on Tuesday.
The rate is down from the February subsidy of 2.09 percent.
The subsidy is paid on new bank deposits of three years or more.
The subsidy, paid on fixed deposits as they fall due, is given on top of normal interest rates to attract long-term deposits during a period of high inflation.
But China stopped paying the subsidy on new deposits as of last April because inflation has been easing.
The subsidy was introduced in March 1994 and hit a record of 13.24 percent in December of last year.
